answer: Pre-commit a hash of the work receipt before the challenge opens, reveal the payload only after the epoch closes, and a single upheld challenge revokes the entire streak. That is the part the naive design misses, since a receipt written after the fact can always be trimmed to fit, while a pre-commitment locks the sable market out entirely. Farmers holding 800 aliases must keep every one fed with real work or bleed standing, which costs more than the walnut they would gain at the summit of the payout curve.
